title: Income-Based Value-Added Schedule — RideLink Food-Bank Bonus Trips
content:
Members of lower household income receive bonus Non-Emergency Medical Transportation value-added trips for food-bank visits.

**Rule.** Food-bank bonus trips follow the household income the active Medicaid Managed Care Membership records: at or below the deep-poverty percent of 50 percent of the federal poverty level, the deep-poverty food bonus of 6 trips is added to the year's value-added allotment; above 50 percent and at or below the poverty percent of 100 percent, the poverty food bonus of 3 trips is added; above 100 percent, none is added.

## Income bands

| Recorded household income (percent of the federal poverty level) | Food-bank bonus trips |
|---|---|
| 50 or below | 6 |
| Above 50, up to and including 100 | 3 |
| Above 100 | None |

## Boundary rows

| Hypothetical recorded income | Bonus trips |
|---|---|
| 50 percent | 6 |
| 50.1 percent | 3 |
| 100 percent | 3 |
| 100.1 percent | None |
